registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre custody is evidenced by the Ayuntamiento de Coatzacoalcos Catastro pages and Veracruz Delegación Regional de Catastro Coatzacoalcos records. State SEMARNAT GIS layers encountered are general environmental/land-use data and are not treated as cadastral sources.
